disclaimer: This is a check against available records, not a legal finding.

onboarding.welcome: Verify standard marks with official records in seconds
onboarding.sub: A calm, neutral civic companion designed for everyday shoppers.
onboarding.step1Desc: Compares product standard marks, licence numbers, and seller claims against public Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) registries.
onboarding.step2Title: What this app does not do
onboarding.step2Desc: We do not declare products fake or illegal. We only report whether claims match available records. Official decisions rest with designated BIS authorities.
onboarding.step3Desc: Camera is used strictly to read marks and text on your device. No account is required to perform checks. Your checks remain on your phone.

home.subtitle: Check if BIS standard mark claims match official records
home.actionScanDesc: Use camera or photo to read mark and licence
home.searchPlaceholder: Search by product, brand, or standard...

capture.title: Capture Product Photos
capture.promptMoveCloser: Move a little closer to the mark
capture.promptReduceGlare: Angle away from direct light to reduce glare
capture.promptGood: Clear focus detected. Ready to capture.

listing.title: Paste Listing Link
listing.subtitle: We extract the product title, seller claims, and images to compare against records

licence.title: Enter Licence Number
licence.subtitle: Look for the 7-digit CM/L number below the ISI mark or R-number below CRS mark
licence.helper: CM/L indicates standard ISI marks. R- indicates electronic registration.

analysis.title: Checking Records
analysis.subtitle: Comparing product details with the official national registry
analysis.honestNote: Each step runs independently. If photo text is blurred, manual correction will be available.

outcomes.noMismatch: No mismatch detected in the available evidence
outcomes.unableToVerify: Unable to verify with available records

evidence.title: Preserved Evidence Trail
evidence.subtitle: Cryptographically hashed artifacts captured during verification
evidence.hashNote: A SHA-256 hash confirms the file has not been altered since capture; it does not prove the underlying product is authentic.

eco.title: EcoLoop – Environmental Guidance
eco.beeDesc: Energy star ratings are governed separately by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE).
eco.disposalDesc: Under the E-Waste Management Rules 2022, manufacturers must provide authorized takeback.

report.title: Submit Inquiry to BIS
report.subtitle: Pre-filled evidence packet formatted for the official BIS Care grievance system
report.consentLabel: I consent to sharing my contact info with BIS officials for verification
report.humanReviewNote: A designated BIS technical officer will review the preserved files and initiate official contact if required.

learn.methodologyTitle: How This App Works & Its Limits
learn.blindspotsText: Public registers may have a 24-48 hour update lag. Missing evidence is never treated as proof of wrongdoing.
